question: Tirupati travels 120 km at the speed of 48 km/hr and another 180 km at the speed 45 km/hr. What is Tirupati’s average speed (in km/hr) during the entire journey? (correct up to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Distance = 120 + 180 = 300 km

Total Time = (120 ÷ 48) + (180 ÷ 45) = 2.5 + 4 = 6.5 hours

Average Speed = 300 ÷ 6.5 = 600 ÷ 13 ≈ 46.15 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 46.15 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance of first part (D₁) = 120 km, Speed (S₁) = 48 km/hr

Distance of second part (D₂) = 180 km, Speed (S₂) = 45 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 Total Distance = 300 km

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time for the first part (T₁) = 120 ÷ 48 = 2.5 hours

⇒ Time for the second part (T₂) = 180 ÷ 45 = 4 hours

⇒ Total Distance = 120 + 180 = 300 km

⇒ Total Time = 2.5 + 4 = 6.5 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 300 ÷ 6.5

⇒ Average Speed = 3000 ÷ 65 = 600 ÷ 13

⇒ Average Speed ≈ 46.1538 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 46.15 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average Speed is the ratio of total distance covered to the total time taken. If equal distances are covered at speeds a and b, Average Speed = 2ab ÷ (a + b).

Relative Speed

If two bodies move in the same direction at speeds a and b (a > b), Relative Speed = (a − b). If moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = (a + b).

Conversion of Units

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5 ÷ 18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.
